reasons: product_identity_match FAIL: The evidence specification explicitly states the filter is 'ordinary operating hardware, NEVER a white AFP carton or a branded roll', yet the image prominently features a large white-blue AFP-branded roll in the foreground.

package_separate_from_plumbing FAIL: A thin black strip/tape emerges from the AFP carton sleeve and runs toward the irrigation pipe; tubing is visible under/near the carton base, violating the requirement for an empty soil gap all around the carton with no pipe through its core and no tubing under its base.

packaging_closed_no_protruding_material FAIL: A black strip protrudes from the AFP carton, making it not a fully closed self-contained package; the rule rejects any protruding strip, strap, or tape tail regardless of color.
crop_stage_match PASS: Role 3 permits neutral tiny seedlings or bare soil; the small green seedlings visible in the field are acceptable.

role_camera_match PASS: The image shows a medium three-quarter technical side view of connected irrigation hardware (black header pipe, screen filter, drip tape lateral) on soil, consistent with role 3.

topic_evidence_match PASS: The scene contains a compact dark screen filter installed on a continuous black irrigation header with a thin black flattened drip-tape lateral at the crop bed, matching the evidence description (excluding the unauthorized AFP carton).
single_product PASS: Exactly one intact white-blue AFP carton is present in the frame.
product_scale_match PASS: The AFP carton occupies approximately 15-20% of frame width and well under 32% of frame height.
product_fully_in_frame PASS: The AFP carton is entirely within the image boundaries.
physical_geometry_plausible PASS: Contact shadows, perspective, and the installed irrigation components appear geometrically coherent with no floating or merged artifacts.
no_people PASS: No people are visible in the image.
no_added_text PASS: Only the permitted deterministic bottom-right phone label is present; no unauthorized text overlays exist.
